methods.name: Burning logs
methods.note: Best logs for your level lit by a bank, coloured logs below 30. Rates assume 1,485 logs an hour, close to tick-perfect.

methods.name: Cutting and burning your own logs
methods.note: Chop the best tree you can and burn the logs where you stand. Oak from 15, teak from 39, mahogany from 50, yew from 60.

methods.name: Pyre logs (1-tick)
methods.note: Tick-perfect sacred oil on redwood or rosewood logs, fastest to 30. Only 29k an hour without tick manipulation.

methods.name: Forester's campfire (automatic)
methods.note: Add logs to a campfire next to a bank and let them feed in. About 150 seconds an inventory, 665 logs an hour.

methods.name: Forester's campfire (manual tending)
methods.note: Hold space and keep tending the campfire by a bank. The guide's ceiling is 975 logs an hour, rates here are 85% of that.

methods.name: Wintertodt
methods.note: Chop and burn bruma roots on an official world, about 4 minutes a game. Needs no supplies and pays out loot crates. Wear warm clothes.

methods.name: Dorgesh-Kaan lamps
methods.note: Fix lamps with light orbs you blow and wire yourself. 90k to 130k Crafting xp an hour on top. A main can buy orbs at 52 Crafting.

unverified: Cutting and burning your own logs: the Ironman Guide gives no hourly rate (it defers to each tree's page), so xph is 0

Forester's campfire (manual tending): the guide's manual column is at 'up to 975 logs per hour'; bands are 85% of those figures per the up-to rule (table values run 39,000 at level 1 to 341,250 at 90)

Burning logs: the level 1 band (74,250) is for coloured logs with a firelighter, which never fail to light; 107,000 and 138,000 include time lost to failed lights; the alternative cheaper campfire progression uses ironwood logs at 80 (146,632 automatic)

Dorgesh-Kaan lamps: taken from the Crafting guides, not the Firemaking guides. 77,500 is the midpoint of the Ironman Guide's 65,000 (learning) and 90,000 (skilled); the main Crafting guide says 100,000 for skilled players. With bought light orbs a main only needs 52 Crafting, but no separate rate is given
Wintertodt: rates are from the main guide for mass worlds without fletching the roots; the Ironman Guide gives no numbers; r2_Wintertodt.txt has no hourly rates
Pyre logs (1-tick), Burning logs, both campfire entries: cost is a judgement call because GP/XP columns are live GE price templates
Omitted for lack of a rate: Shades of Mort'ton minigame (5+), solo Wintertodt, rosewood logs at 92 (the guide only says about four hours slower than redwood to 99)
